question: Where can I get the locations of electrical substations in France (transmission and distribution), with voltage level and operator?

answer.summary: France has no single open substation dataset covering both transmission and distribution with coordinates, voltage, and operator. Distribution (HTA/BT) is well covered by Agence ORE (1,033,309 public substations across 47 operators, ~98.9% of communes) plus Enedis (976,678) and EDM Mayotte (673). For transmission/primary (HTB), RTE and EDF SEI removed GPS coordinates from Open Data for public security: ODRÉ keeps all 5,042 RTE nodes with voltage by département only, Caparéseau gives coords and HTB class (u_max) for 3,116 continental S3REnR substations (40 bad coords, 1,285 RTE sites missing), and IGN BD TOPO gives 4,133 footprints (>=63 kV, DROM included) without voltage.
main_caveats: RTE (ODRÉ), EDF SEI, and Enedis deleted/restricted HTB poste-source GPS coordinates for public security; no official coordinate feed covers all 4,232 RTE transformation substations.
Legacy ODS APIs on Agence ORE, Enedis, and EDF SEI return 404/410; platforms migrated to Data Fair (/data-fair/api/v1/datasets), while ODRÉ and EDM Mayotte still use Opendatasoft v2.1.
Caparéseau excludes Corse (filtered in UI JS), DROM-COM, and 1,285 RTE HTB sites, merges 225kV and 400kV into u_max=6, and contains 40 invalid coords near (-1.36, -5.98).
IGN BD TOPO includes all >=63kV & rail substations across Metro, Corse, DROM, St-Martin/St-Barthélemy (4,133 polygons) but omits voltage and leaves sources blank on 81.1%.
Agence ORE HTA/BT omits ~63 small ELDs (~1.1% of communes), Mayotte (673 posts on EDM), COM (NC, PF, SPM, WF), and private HTA/BT substations; SRD's ORE table has 4x duplicate rows.
answer.confidence_reason: All core official portals, Data Fair/ODS APIs, Caparéseau JSON endpoints, IGN WFS layers, and overseas catalogs were directly queried and cross-checked locally on 2026-11-15.

attributes.note: HTA/BT coords in ORE (1,033,309) + Enedis (976,678) + EDM (673); HTB coords in Capareseau (3,076 valid metro), IGN BD TOPO (4,133 polygons), EDM (3).
attributes.gap_note: 1,285 RTE postes de transformation lack coords in Capareseau/ODRÉ; EDF SEI postes-sources are metadata-only; ~63 small ELDs (~1.1% communes), COM & private HTA/BT absent.

attributes.note: ODRÉ RTE gives exact tension (<45kV to 400kV) without coords; Capareseau gives u_max tier (merges 225/400kV in u_max=6); ORE/Enedis/EDM imply HTA/BT (20kV/400V).
attributes.gap_note: IGN BD TOPO >=63kV polygons carry no voltage field; 1,285 RTE sites have voltage in ODRÉ without coordinates; 404 Capareseau nodes leave htb_type blank.

attributes.note: 100% nom_grd on ORE (47 GRDs); implicit RTE on ODRÉ and Enedis/EDM on own portals; Capareseau exposes grd1/grd2/grdHTB and joins to RTE via code.

All 1,033,309 coordinates fall inside valid Metro/Corse/DOM/St-Martin/St-Barthélemy bboxes (incl. 340 under EDF Archipel Guadeloupe in St-Martin/St-Barthélemy), with 0 rows in Mayotte.

key_fields.meaning: 5-character RTE substation code (matches ODRÉ code_poste for 2,947 of 3,116 sites).
WGS84 lon/lat (X, Y) and Lambert-93 (EPSG:2154) coordinates; 40 sites have dummy coords near (-1.36, -5.98).
Numeric HTB voltage tier: 2~45kV, 3~63kV, 4~90kV, 5~150kV, 6~225kV or 400kV (merges both); rare errors: 1 (4), 7 (6), 225 (2).
Domain label ('HTA': 1461, 'HTA / HTB1': 622, 'HTB1 / HTA': 418, 'HTB1': 211, '': 404).
Nested dicts {'asset', 'name'} naming connected DSOs (Enedis 2,415, ELDs, null on 581 grd1; grdHTB on 49 ELD HTB sites).
'0' = existing substation (3,087), '1' = planned project (29, of which 23 have dummy coords).

steps: Fetch each of the 12 continental region pages https://www.capareseau.fr/region/{11,24,27,28,32,44,52,53,75,76,84,93} and extract the regional /medias/<UUID> JSON link whose array elements contain 'u_max' (ignoring /medias/68FF5E37... which is the 3,128-entry index JSON).
Filter out the 40 records whose coordinates fall near (-1.36, -5.98) (dummy placeholder from Lambert-93 origin ~0,0) and separate project='1' (29 planned) from project='0' (3,087 existing).

Join on code == code_poste against ODRÉ postes-electriques-rte (rank 3) to split u_max=6 into exact 225kV vs 400kV and assign RTE as TSO operator for the 2,947 matched sites (the remaining 144 existing sites are DSO/ELD/SNCF non-RTE posts).
reading_traps: Region HTML embeds two JSON UUIDs: /medias/68FF5E37-A6AE-CCF4-D16B-92BDC82043AC is a national index without coordinates/u_max; parse the region-specific UUID containing 'u_max'.
40 sites (23 planned project='1' and 17 existing project='0') have dummy WGS84 coordinates around X=-1.36, Y=-5.98 (Atlantic Ocean south of Liberia) from unpopulated Lambert-93 (0,0).
u_max=6 combines both 225 kV (609 matched RTE sites) and 400 kV (99 matched RTE sites); 2 records put literal '225' and 10 put anomalous codes 1 or 7.
grd1/grd2/grdHTB are objects {'asset':..., 'name':...}, not plain strings, and grd1=None on 581 sites (RTE/SNCF-only or pure HTB).

problems: 40 records have placeholder coordinates near (-1.36, -5.98); Corse and DROM-COM excluded; 1,285 RTE Poste de transformation sites missing.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (Geofabrik France extract & Infos-Réseaux derivatives)
sources.format: OSM PBF (5.12 GB full France extract; Overpass API also exists)
sources.adds: Best non-official structured source filling voltage=* and operator=* tags across high-voltage RTE, railway traction, and overseas substations where Caparéseau and IGN BD TOPO omit names/voltages.

coverage.geographic: Metropolitan France & Corse in france-latest.osm.pbf (separate Geofabrik extracts for DOM/COM); crowdsourced completeness varies (high on HTB, partial on urban/rural HTA/BT).

unit.value: OpenStreetMap node, way, or relation tagged power=substation (with optional substation=transmission|distribution, voltage=*, operator=*, ref:FR:RTE=*).

inclusion_rule.value: Community-mapped features digitized from aerial imagery, field survey, or earlier RTE/Enedis open data imports.

exclusions.value: Crowd-sourced coverage varies; france-latest.osm.pbf covers mainland France + Corse (overseas territories are in regional Geofabrik extracts); Overpass live queries frequently rate-limit/timeout.

key_fields.meaning: Identifies electrical substations and distinguishes transmission vs distribution/traction.
Nominal voltage(s) in volts (e.g. '225000', '400000;63000').
Operator (e.g. 'RTE', 'Enedis', 'SER') and 5-char RTE code where mapped.

steps: Download france-latest.osm.pbf (~5.12 GB) from Geofabrik instead of hitting public Overpass API endpoints (which returned 406/timeout in testing).
Filter locally with osmium tags-filter france-latest.osm.pbf power=substation -o fr-substations.osm.pbf and export GeoJSON/centroids via osmium export.
Match against IGN BD TOPO polygons or ODRÉ RTE code_poste / nom_poste to recover locations and voltages for the 1,285 RTE sites omitted from Caparéseau.
reading_traps: Public Overpass instances (overpass-api.de, overpass.private.coffee, maps.mail.ru) failed with 406 Not Acceptable or timeouts during testing; use Geofabrik PBF for reliable access.
OSM ODbL share-alike obligations may apply to derived databases.

problems: Full 5.12 GB PBF not downloaded due to size; Overpass API endpoints returned HTTP 406 or timed out.

evidence.claim: Geofabrik provides an active daily France OSM PBF download (5.12 GB, updated 2026-11-15).

operators.note: Single national transmission operator RTE (>50 kV in continental France, ~100,000 km lines, ~4,000 substations per ministry; 5,042 nodes incl. 810 points de piquage in ODRÉ). Distribution split between Enedis (~95% of continental territory, ~800k-977k HTA/BT) and ~150-160 ELDs (~5%), plus EDF SEI in ZNI (Corse, Guadeloupe, Martinique, Guyane, Réunion, St-Barthélemy, St-Martin), EDM in Mayotte, and separate operators in NC/PF/SPM/WF.

publication_obligation.norm: Article 179 de la loi n° 2015-992 du 17 août 2015 (LTECV) et dispositions associées du Code de l'énergie, suivis par la délibération CRE n° 2018-214
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Local energy and grid infrastructure data made available by electricity and gas network operators (detailed in Agence ORE methodology note v7.4 citing LTECV Art. 179 and CRE 2018-214).
publication_obligation.frequency: At least annual per Agence ORE methodological note (semiannual updates on Agence ORE / Enedis Data Fair; quarterly on IGN BD TOPO).

consolidated_republication.note: Yes for public HTA/BT distribution via Agence ORE (47 GRDs, 98.9% of communes) and RTE+GRDs on Caparéseau (3,116 continental S3REnR sites); no single aggregator republishes all HTB+HTA/BT coordinates due to public-security removals on postes-sources and RTE ODRÉ.

checked_pages.saw: Consolidates 1,033,309 public HTA/BT distribution substations across 47 GRDs (98.9% of communes), while its postes-sources dataset (uaj207yrh6s4iw1s00tnhhi6) is metadata-only due to public security.
Publishes all 5,042 RTE HTB substations and points de piquage with tension and departement, but removed GPS coordinates for public security.
Policy overview of RTE, Enedis, and ~150 ELDs without hosting a national substation coordinate table.
29 CRE open datasets (tariffs, interconnections, quality indicators), none containing substation locations.
Federates Enedis HTA/BT, EDF SEI, IGN BD TOPO, and local DDT/EPCI subsets, but lacks a unified transmission + distribution substation registry.

national_registry.note: No single national registry provides complete coordinates, voltage levels, and operators for all French transmission and distribution substations; transmission GPS coordinates were intentionally withdrawn from RTE (ODRÉ) and EDF SEI/Enedis (postes-sources) for public security.

checked_pages.saw: 29 datasets published by CRE; none map electrical substations.
Describes institutional split (RTE, Enedis, 150 ELDs); no consolidated substation database.
Consolidated postes-sources dataset has isMetaOnly=true and 0 records with security notice; only HTA/BT distribution (s9uotlfur5l1t2hzpixpcpia) has active point records.
All 5,042 RTE substations/taps listed with tension and departement; GPS coordinates explicitly removed.
BD TOPO poste_de_transformation covers >=63kV enclosures nationwide (4,133 polygons) without voltage attributes or HTA/BT distribution posts.
Catalog search for 'postes electriques' (17 top matches) yields Enedis distribution, EDF SEI non-spatial counts, IGN BD TOPO, and local DDT/EPCI mirrors—no unified national table.

recipe: Take the 1,285 RTE 'Poste de transformation' sites present in ODRÉ (rank 3) but absent from Caparéseau (rank 2), along with EDF SEI's 101 named postes-sources (rank 6).
Match against IGN BD TOPO >= 63 kV footprints (rank 4) using spatial intersection with BDTOPO_V3:ligne_electrique (which exposes exact 'voltage' and 'gestionnaire') and OSM power=substation (rank 8).

For remaining unlocated or newly planned HTB/DUP projects (75 ACCORD ADMINISTRATIF nodes in ODRÉ, 23 unlocated project='1' nodes in Caparéseau), search Projets & Environnement / IGEDD Ae PDFs by nom_poste and département to extract commune, parcel area, lieu-dit, voltage, and operator.
if_unstructured.location_method: Locate candidate polygons in BDTOPO_V3:poste_de_transformation within the commune named in the Ae/DUP PDF, verify enclosure geometry and connected line voltages via IGN BD ORTHO 20 cm orthophotography and BDTOPO_V3:ligne_electrique, and optionally check cadastral parcel boundaries in Parcellaire Express.

open_questions: No official open substation datasets were found across New Caledonia (all 375 datasets on data.gouv.nc scanned -> generation plants only; georep.nc; enercal.nc 150/33 kV narrative only), French Polynesia (all 101 datasets on tefenua.data.gov.pf scanned -> 0 electrical substation datasets), or Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon (data.gouv.fr generation-only); obtaining substation data there requires direct operator requests (Enercal, EEC, EDT, EEWF, EDF).
Whether RTE will publish a generalized/coarsened open alternative to the removed ODRÉ GPS coordinates as mentioned in its dataset description ('RTE travaille à des solutions alternatives').
Direct programmatic HTTP access to Légifrance returned 403 Forbidden; PISTE API registration would be needed to fetch full Code de l'énergie / DUP texts automatically.

history.note: Initial pass across CRE, Ministry, ORE, Enedis, RTE/ODRE, Capareseau, IGN, EDF SEI, EDM Mayotte, ELDs, COM portals, OSM, JRC/PyPSA, and commercial.

local_terms.meaning: Electrical substation housing transformers and switchgear connecting different voltage levels (4,232 in RTE ODRÉ; 4,133 >=63 kV polygons in IGN BD TOPO).
Primary HTB/HTA (or HTB/HTB) interface substation connecting the high-voltage transmission grid to medium-voltage public distribution (3,116 S3REnR sites in Caparéseau; 3 in EDM Mayotte).
Public medium-to-low voltage distribution transformer substation (typically 20 kV to 400 V; 1,033,309 in Agence ORE).
Tee/tap junction point on a transmission line (810 nodes in RTE ODRÉ), not a standalone transformation enclosure.
French voltage tiers: HTB (>50 kV transmission: HTB1 63/90kV, HTB2 150/225kV, HTB3 400kV), HTA (1–50 kV, typically 20 kV), BT (<=1 kV, typically 400/230 V).
GRT = transmission operator (RTE); GRD = distribution operator (Enedis on 95% + ~150-160 ELDs / Entreprises Locales de Distribution on ~5%).
Zones non interconnectées (Corse, Guadeloupe, Martinique, Guyane, Réunion, Mayotte, St-Barthélemy, St-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Wallis-et-Futuna, îles du Ponant; excludes NC and PF).
Schéma régional de raccordement au réseau des énergies renouvelables; governs substation hosting capacities published on Caparéseau.
